# AI Research Digest

AI Research Digest is a source-linked research workflow MVP for overseas researchers.

Primary topic: AI tools and workflows for researchers.
Editorial pilot: AI and politics, including AI governance, algorithmic governance, AI and international relations, and platform politics.

## Citation policy

Use the source URL shown on each digest page. Treat sample records as editorial demonstrations, not systematic reviews. Separate author findings from editorial synthesis and note limitations.

## Site map

- /: product overview and recent digests
- /digest.html: searchable digest library
- /methodology.html: editorial and quality method
- /portfolio-evidence.html: eight-project evidence map
- /decision-readouts.html: product decision readouts for EvalKit, Social Lab, Digest Agent, SQL teardown, and ad compliance
